newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan may set up bank if institution fails--Jiji.
newsitem.headline: Japan may set up bank if institution fails--Jiji.

text.p: Japan may set up a new bank to take over the business of a financial institution in the event that the institution fails, Jiji news agency quoted a senior Finance Ministry official as saying on Friday.

Kimio Yamaguchi, director-general of the ministry's Banking Bureau, was quoted as saying that in case of a failure at a financial institution, the government may set up a new bank in addition to the Resolution and Collection Bank Ltd (RCB).
The RCB was set up last year to handle bankruptcies of credit unions over the past two years and to deal with possible future failures of such financial institutions.
